title: Figure Specification + Generation Metadata
description: One entry per figure. Used as the sidecar JSON next to each rendered image, and as the structured return value of graphics worker agents.

figure_id.description: Stable identifier (e.g. F-01). Must match drafts/figures_register.md.

type.description: Figure kind. Determines which worker handles it.

model_version.description: Fal.ai model id (e.g. fal-ai/flux-pro/v1.1-ultra, fal-ai/ideogram/v2) or library version for programmatic generators.

location.description: Target draft file + section where the figure is rendered (e.g. drafts/03_1_technical_maturity.md §3.1).

owner.description: Human/role responsible for the figure's content (e.g. PE, DT-Lead, PM, CFO, Comm, Legal, Site).

data_inputs.description: Paths or SRC/CLM identifiers the figure is built from.

script_path.description: Path to the Python/Mermaid/Graphviz source that reproduces the figure.

seed.description: Deterministic seed used at generation time.

output_path.description: Path to the rendered PNG/SVG relative to repo root.
